guarantees.claim: Message share inputs msg_i[0] and msg_i[1] are connected to prim_packer_fifo instances that pack from MsgLen to MsgWidth with ClearOnRead enabled and clr_i deasserted.
msg_valid_i drives write-valid of both share FIFOs, and both FIFOs share the same read-ready signal msg_ready.
msg_ready_o is the logical AND of the write-ready outputs from both share FIFOs.
msg_valid is the logical AND of the read-valid outputs from both share FIFOs.

assumptions.claim: The external producer must obey the valid/ready handshake: msg_valid_i must be asserted with stable msg_i shares, and must be deasserted after accepted (msg_ready_o asserted).
assumptions.risk: If the producer violates handshake (e.g., changes data before acceptance or retracts valid), the FIFOs may capture corrupt data or stall indefinitely.

uncertain_points.claim: When EnMasking=0, NumShares=1, the unconditional instantiation of u_msg_unpacker_share1 references msg_i[1] which is out-of-bounds, causing an elaboration failure.
uncertain_points.risk: Design fails to elaborate, preventing use of the security-weak unmasked configuration for evaluation or reset.

uncertain_points.claim: The signal msg_ready, used as read-ready for both FIFOs, is not driven within this chunk; it must be provided by downstream logic to pop data.
uncertain_points.cond: when data is ready in FIFOs
uncertain_points.risk: If msg_ready is never asserted, the unpacked message will never be read and the system stalls.

uncertain_points.claim: msg_mask_en is declared but not used; the message (re-)masking block (lines 145-149) has no active logic, leaving masking potentially unimplemented despite the SCA protection intent.
uncertain_points.risk: Message shares may not be re-masked before use, weakening differential power analysis resistance.
